description: This Java source file defines the JpaCustomerDao class, which implements data access operations for Customer entities in a SQL database within the Thingsboard project. It includes methods for querying customers by tenant ID, name, external ID, and other criteria, utilizing Spring Data JPA repositories and utility classes.

classes.name: JpaCustomerDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for Customer entities, providing methods to query and manipulate customer data in a SQL database, using Spring Data JPA and utility classes.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides the JpaRepository instance for CustomerEntity.

methods.name: findCustomersByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of customers associated with a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: findCustomerByTenantIdAndTitle
methods.description: Finds a customer by tenant ID and customer title.

methods.name: findPublicCustomerByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the public customer for a given tenant ID.

methods.name: countByTenantId
methods.description: Counts the number of customers for a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds a customer by tenant ID and external ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a customer by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Alias for findCustomersByTenantId, retrieves customers by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a customer given its internal ID.

methods.name: findCustomersWithTheSameTitle
methods.description: Finds customers with the same title, paginated.

methods.name: findCustomersByTenantIdAndIds
methods.description: Finds customers by tenant ID and a list of customer IDs.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all customers for a tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Finds the next batch of CustomerFields for a given customer ID.

methods.name: findEntityInfosByNamePrefix
methods.description: Finds entity info objects by tenant ID and name prefix.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is CUSTOMER.
